held.title: Waiting for approval
held.description: A post written by an author is not sent to subscribers until you release it. Release it to send the post to the confirmed subscribers of its language, or discard it: it is kept as a record and never sent. The post itself is not changed. What you see here is what subscribers would read. If the author changes the post after this page loaded, the release is refused and the new text is shown for you to read again. Once released, the title, excerpt and language are stored, so a later edit changes neither the email nor who gets it.
